dimensions.assessment: Directly impacts active duty aircrew veterans of fixed-wing aircraft through a study of their health data.
dimensions.evidence: individuals who served on active duty in the Army, Navy, Air Force, or Marine Corps as an aircrew member of a fixed-wing aircraft

dimensions.assessment: Initiates a research study and report on cancer rates without directly altering individual veteran benefits in the text.
dimensions.evidence: conduct a study on the prevalence and mortality of cancers among covered individuals.

dimensions.assessment: Requires an agreement to fund a study, but does not specify the total monetary cost of the contract.
dimensions.evidence: Secretary of Veterans Affairs shall seek to enter into an agreement with the National Academies

dimensions.assessment: Mandates a specific research project and reporting requirements for federal agencies and external scientific bodies.
dimensions.evidence: To provide for a study by the National Academies of Sciences, Engineering, and Medicine

dimensions.assessment: Involves a one-time study and resulting report delivered to Congress and the VA.
dimensions.evidence: At the conclusion of the study required under subsection (a), the National Academies shall submit... a report

missing_information: The exact financial cost of the agreement with the National Academies is not specified.
importance_detail.rationale: Requires the Department of Veterans Affairs to contract with the National Academies of Sciences, Engineering, and Medicine to study cancer prevalence and mortality among specific veteran aircrew members.
